description:
Carry a `data_extract` file (and its `-konfiguracja.json`) from one server to another,
    relayed through this agent's machine - the two servers never need to reach each other.
    On the hosted gateway (zoxron.com/mcp) "this machine" is the Zoxron server: tell the
    owner the file passes through it and is deleted right after the transfer.
    A 19 -> 20 move is always two servers (one Odoo major per box), and the file used to
    travel by hand-typed scp.

    The file holds personal data and usually the mail server password, so it is never
    readable by anyone but its owner: a short-lived 600 copy for the ssh user on the
    source, a private temp dir here (removed afterwards), and on the target
    `/tmp/zx-przenies` 700, the file 600 owned by `odoo` (who runs `data_load`). sha256
    is compared end to end; a mismatch is an error, not a warning. Read-only on the source
    database (it only copies a file out).
name: data_transfer
